title: [CI] PostSecretResponseTests testEqualsAndHashcode failing
body:
It failed only once, but was reproducible. So it appears that this specific random seed causes the test to mutate the instance to the exact same value as the original. Should be easy to fix in the mutateInstance method.

**Build scan:**
https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/hq337lsl2haig/tests/:x-pack:plugin:fleet:test/org.elasticsearch.xpack.fleet.action.PostSecretResponseTests/testEqualsAndHashcode


**Reproduction line:**
```
./gradlew ':x-pack:plugin:fleet:test' --tests "org.elasticsearch.xpack.fleet.action.PostSecretResponseTests.testEqualsAndHashcode" -Dtests.seed=911048E119C6824D -Dtests.locale=ja-JP-u-ca-japanese-x-lvariant-JP -Dtests.timezone=America/Goose_Bay -Druntime.java=19
```

**Applicable branches:**
main

Yes
